title: EnderMorph Datapack
body:
# EnderMorph Datapack

Become an Enderman and unlock powerful new abilities in vanilla Minecraft!

This datapack introduces the **EnderMorph Potion**, allowing you to transform into an Enderman and wield its unique powers. Master teleportation, manipulate entities from a distance, and embrace both the strengths and weaknesses of your new form.

**Make sure to also download the required resourcepack**

**Watch the video below for a full showcase and tutorial!**

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/tkFkxh87-WA" title="YouTube-Videoplayer" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

---

## Become an Enderman

After drinking the **EnderMorph Potion**, you'll gain access to four powerful Enderman abilities:

- **Teleport Pointer** – Right-click to instantly teleport to the location you're looking at.
- **Phase Through Walls** – Stand next to a wall and right-click to teleport through it.
- **Random Teleport** – Sneak while holding right-click to randomly teleport nearby.
- **Telekinesis** – Sneak and right-click on an entity to pull it toward you.

## Enderman Weaknesses

Power comes at a cost.

While transformed, you'll also inherit the classic Enderman weaknesses:

- Water damages you
- Rain hurts you as well

Choose your battles wisely!

## Brewing the EnderMorph Potion

To brew the potion, you'll first need an **Enderheart**, a new rare drop obtained from Endermen.

### Brewing Recipe

Gather:

- 1 × Enderheart
- 2 × Ender Eyes
- 4 × Warped Roots

Place the ingredients into a **filled cauldron**, then collect the finished potion using a glass bottle.

## Survival Friendly

- Fully obtainable in survival
- New rare Enderman drop
- Unique gameplay mechanics without any mods

Have fun becoming an Enderman! If you enjoy the datapack, consider leaving a like on the showcase video and subscribing on YouTube—it really helps support future datapacks!
